experiences.job_description:
Robat Karim Wastewater Treatment Plant,
- Oversee the construction, installation, and commissioning of wastewater treatment plant components, ensuring compliance with environmental and safety regulations.
- Utilize AutoCAD, Microsoft Project, and Excel to streamline project planning, documentation, and performance tracking.
- Developed Excel-based tracking systems for cost monitoring and resource allocation, enhancing budget control.

Part 2 and 3 of the Water Transfer, Irrigation Network, and Drainage Project of the Garmsiri,
- Oversaw the construction and deployment of an 142 km water transmission pipeline, ensuring a dependable and efficient water supply for Sarpol-e Zahab.
- Led on-site inspections and troubleshooting for pipeline installations, addressing construction challenges effectively.
- Supervised pipeline construction, pumping stations, and water storage reservoirs, ensuring proper material selection and hydraulic performance.

Jahrom City Water Supply Project and Water Treatment Plant Construction,
- Supervised the construction and installation of a 50 km water transmission pipeline, ensuring efficient water distribution for Jahrom City.
- Prepared technical documentation, project schedules, and cost estimates, monitoring budget compliance and resource allocation.
- Successfully improved project workflow efficiency, reducing construction delays by 14% through effective planning and risk management.

Procurement, Construction, Test and Commissioning of: Interceptors and Laterals of Zones 3 and 5 of Abadeh Wastewater project,
- Successfully oversaw the construction of 60 km of sewer pipelines and the installation of interceptors and laterals, enhancing the efficiency of the wastewater collection network in Zones 3 and 5 of Abadeh.
- Provided technical reports, cost estimations, and project documentation, supporting financial and regulatory compliance.

Construction of Wastewater Pipeline to Pardis Wastewater Treatment Plant,
- Successfully oversaw the installation of 4.19 km of wastewater pipelines, improving the collection and transportation of wastewater to the Pardis Wastewater Treatment Plant.
- Implemented advanced construction methodologies, including pipe jacking (microtunneling) for 95 meters of concrete pipeline, reducing environmental impact.
- Delivered the project on time and within budget, despite complex site conditions and technical challenges.

Construction of Water Pipeline from Mamlo Dam to Southern Tehran.
- Successfully completed the installation of a 5.5 km, 1200 mm water transmission pipeline, managing 8 complex pipe jacking operations to ensure safe underground crossings while enhancing water quality and distribution efficiency for the Soleimanieh Reservoir.
- Implemented optimized construction methodologies, reducing project delays by 17% and improving cost efficiency.

Water Pipeline Construction from Azadi Dam to Eslam Abad Gharb and Kerend Project (Including Tunnel Construction, Pipeline Installation, and Water Storage Cistern).
- Successfully contributed to the installation of 32 km of water pipelines, enhancing the water supply infrastructure for Eslam Abad Gharb and Kerend.
- Assisted in the preparation of detailed design plans, drawings, and technical documentation for pipeline alignment, tunnel excavation, and water storage cistern construction.

Water Pipeline Construction from Mamlo Dam to Tehran.
- Provided technical support for the successful installation of 9 km of water transmission pipeline, enhancing the water supply system for Tehran.
- Assisting in the preparation, organization, and archiving of project documents, drawings, and reports for future reference.
